exemplar rationale

  • CURIE: gmeow:exemplarRationale
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exemplarRationale
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Why this is an exemplar — the judgement prose. NOT functional and range-open (localizable-prose convention): localizable, one rationale per language tag; whose judgement it is rides the statement layer.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:Exemplar -> ?

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:exemplarRationale from gmeow:Exemplar to ? when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Exemplar

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use to carry the judgement prose explaining why a passage or subject is an exemplar — one rationale per language tag.

Avoid when

  • Avoid encoding whose judgement it is in the literal (that rides the statement layer) and avoid two same-language rationales — it is localizable, one per language tag.

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:exemplarRationale on the gmeow:Exemplar with language-tagged prose; attribute the judgement via the statement layer when it is contested.

Examples

  • ex:ex1 gmeow:exemplarRationale "models agency under constraint"@en.
